LightningComponentBundle.description: Record-page toolbar for Account, Contact, Lead, Opportunity and Case: one primary action (Screen Flow or standard New Task/Event/Case form with prefilled fields) + optional one-click Einstein AI summary.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card title (override)
property.description: Leave empty to use the dictionary default ('Quick actions').

property.name: accentColor
property.label: Accent color (CSS)
property.description: Optional CSS color for the icon badge + primary button. Example: '#003DA5'. Leave empty for neutral theme.

property.name: disablePrimaryAction
property.label: Disable primary action button
property.description: Turn ON to hide the primary action button entirely (keep only the AI summary).

property.name: primaryActionLabel
property.label: Primary action label (override)
property.description: Leave empty for dictionary default ('Start visit' / 'Démarrer une visite').

property.name: primaryActionIcon
property.label: Primary action icon (SLDS)
property.description: Example: 'utility:routing_offline' for a field visit, 'utility:new' for a quick create.

property.name: primaryActionType
property.label: Primary action type
property.description: 'flow' launches the Screen Flow below (Account: visit). 'newRecord' opens the standard New form of newRecordObjectApiName with the prefilled fields below (Contact / Lead / Opportunity / Case: Task, Event, Case, Opportunity…).

property.name: newRecordObjectApiName
property.label: [newRecord] Object to create
property.description: API name of the standard object, e.g. Task, Event, Case, Opportunity. Same targets as the standard quick actions NewTask / NewEvent / NewCase / NewOpportunity.

property.name: newRecordDefaults
property.label: [newRecord] Prefilled fields
property.description: Pipe-separated Field=Value pairs. Tokens: {recordId}, {objectApiName}. Example on a Contact: WhoId={recordId}|Subject=Rendez-vous.

property.name: primaryActionFlowApiName
property.label: Primary action Flow API name
property.description: Developer name of the Screen Flow launched when the button is clicked. The current record Id is passed as 'recordId'. Default = 'CCO_FR_Start_Visit' (shipped with the component — creates a standard Event rattaché au record). Clear to display a 'Not configured' toast while wiring, or point at your own Screen Flow.

property.name: disableAiSummary
property.label: Disable AI summary button
property.description: Off by default — the AI summary button is shown. Turn ON to hide it.

property.name: aiSummaryLabel
property.label: AI summary button label (override)
property.description: Leave empty for dictionary default ('AI summary' / 'Résumé IA').

property.name: promptTemplateApiName
property.label: Prompt template API name
property.description: Developer name of the Einstein Prompt Template. Default: SDO-shipped Account summary.

property.name: promptInputApiName
property.label: Prompt template input API name
property.description: Typically 'Input:Account'. Change to 'Input:Contact', 'Input:Opportunity' etc. depending on the host record page.

property.name: autoRunOnLoad
property.label: Run AI summary automatically on load
property.description: When ON (and AI summary enabled), the prompt fires as soon as the component mounts — no click needed.
